summary: Adopter guide for moving heavy CI jobs off the PR path without weakening required checks.
migration_impact: Optional read for adopters reshaping CI; no workflow import required. Sync the doc via gh plate import-payload when upgrading plate-core.
migration_guidance: Read docs/migration/ci-cd-split-guidance.md before removing OS matrices or installer jobs from PR workflows.
Keep branch protection on labels, test, and pr-gates; do not require check names from workflows that do not run on every pull_request (pending checks block merges).
Job-level if: skips satisfy required checks; workflow-level filters that skip the whole workflow do not.
Run post-merge or release pipelines after integration merges to catch platform-specific regressions.
agent_notes: PLATES-CORE block id ci-cd-split-heavy-jobs holds sync-safe bullet guidance. actions-cost-rollout link points at akasper/plate main (not in default payload). Do not edit the separate CI speed checklist page for #1283.
